name: Katie's Corruption
source:
Katie urgently needs a large sum of money to pay for her mother's surgery, but the only person who can help her in her hour of need is the lecherous Mr. Wright, who has impure designs towards the young medical student.

The game shares the universe with and is set after the events of the digital comic "[url=https://e-hentai.org/tag/artist:3diddly]Hannah's Corruption[/url]".
translation:
凯蒂急需一大笔钱来支付母亲的手术费用，但在她需要的时候唯一能帮助她的人就是好色的赖特先生，他对这位年轻的医学生有着不纯的企图。

该游戏与数字漫画“[url=https://e-hentai.org/tag/artist:3diddly]Hannah's Corruption[/url]”的事件共享宇宙并以该事件为背景。
